name: Klára Novotná
bio:
Klára Novotná’s journey into motorsport PR was a serendipitous blend of her communications background and a lifelong fascination with roaring engines. After graduating with a degree in journalism from Charles University, she spent several years honing her skills in corporate communications before a chance encounter at a local rally ignited her passion for motorsport. She joined a small racing team initially, handling media relations and gradually building her expertise in the unique demands of the sport.

Her approach to PR is meticulous and detail-oriented, believing that every interaction with the media and fans contributes to the overall image of the team. Klára is known for her ability to craft compelling narratives that highlight the human element behind the high-speed action. She's particularly skilled at navigating the often-complex world of motorsport regulations and presenting information in a clear, accessible manner. 

What sets Klára apart is her unwavering loyalty and dedication to her team, ALL-INKL.COM Münnich Motorsport. She works tirelessly to promote their achievements and foster a positive relationship with the motorsport community, often working behind the scenes to ensure every detail is perfect.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, neatly styled with a slight wave
physical.description: Klára is a slender woman with a composed demeanor and a warm, approachable smile.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten notes and ideas.
Insists on brewing her own herbal tea every afternoon, claiming it helps her focus.
Has a habit of meticulously straightening items on her desk, even when they're already perfectly aligned.
